record_scope: Completed hypothetical example, not a deployment or measured model evaluation

original_claim.loss: At least one annotated policy-required source position remains unmasked

population.sampling_assumption: Independent and identically distributed from the same fixed population

policy.required_content: All annotated personal names, email addresses, and phone numbers belonging to any mentioned person

mechanism.extractor: Fixed deterministic parameter f; no model instantiated
mechanism.gate: Valid decoding, extraction, tuples and rendering; input length at most 4,096 code points

update.rule: Extend every thresholded span one code point on either side; clip at boundaries and union with old masks

justification.relation: L1 <= L0 pointwise on all relevant released inputs
justification.basis: Original mask set is included and replacement is total on validated inputs
justification.confidence_event: Same original event; no additional confidence allocation

applicability.status: Conditional record of the hypothetical justification, not proof that its assumptions hold in an implementation or population

conditions.population_and_unit: Same justified target population and complete-conversation release and sampling unit, with the stated independence assumptions
conditions.policy_and_labels: Same protected subjects, required positions and loss; audit labels correctly and independently cover the declared policy
conditions.delivered_channels: Only the specified rendered UTF-8 text is delivered; no additional source text, metadata or other observable representation is supplied
conditions.acceptance_and_masks: Every original g0 acceptance decision is preserved, and the complete rendered mask contains the original mask on every relevant accepted input
conditions.audit_and_confidence: The original sampling and confidence procedure remains applicable; inheritance follows from the structural relation, not dominance observed only on audited examples

applicability.time_scope: No automatic calendar expiry is assigned. Use outside the stated source or period requires justification that the population assumptions remain applicable.
applicability.effect_of_a_change: A change stops automatic extension to the changed mechanism or scope, not the original claim within its valid original scope. Evidence that an original assumption was false requires separate reassessment of that original claim.

changes_requiring_reassessment.change: A recipient-visible channel or representation is added or altered
changes_requiring_reassessment.stop_extension_when: The existing loss or concealment argument does not cover the complete new observation
changes_requiring_reassessment.reassessment: Establish output equivalence or concealment for all delivered channels; otherwise evaluate the affected representation using existing labels where adequate and add evidence only where coverage is missing

changes_requiring_reassessment.change: Protected subjects, content, annotation rules or labels change
changes_requiring_reassessment.stop_extension_when: The original policy-to-loss relation or annotation coverage is no longer justified
changes_requiring_reassessment.reassessment: Map old and new required positions. A narrower policy may inherit a bound under compatible outputs and acceptance but weakens the promise; a broader policy needs labels covering the additions. Correct audit-label errors and recompute affected evidence

changes_requiring_reassessment.change: Acceptance decisions change, including through changed scores or failure handling
changes_requiring_reassessment.stop_extension_when: The same-gate preservation argument no longer applies
changes_requiring_reassessment.reassessment: Recompute from linked retained audit labels when the sampling and selection assumptions permit. Otherwise use a justified transfer calculation with retention uncertainty or obtain the missing evidence; do not automatically require a full new audit

changes_requiring_reassessment.change: Extraction, offsets, mask construction or rendering changes
changes_requiring_reassessment.stop_extension_when: Original-mask inclusion on the actual delivered output is no longer structurally justified
changes_requiring_reassessment.reassessment: Establish an end-to-end preservation relation or reevaluate the affected outputs against adequate existing labels. Regression examples alone do not prove pointwise inheritance

changes_requiring_reassessment.change: Input source, population scope, release grouping or sampling unit changes
changes_requiring_reassessment.stop_extension_when: The original sampling or unit-level loss no longer supports the proposed population claim
changes_requiring_reassessment.reassessment: Justify reuse of the existing sample and regroup linked records where valid. Recompute the appropriate loss and uncertainty; collect evidence for the changed population or unit only where existing information is insufficient

separate_restriction_comparison.decision: Original 0.1% target not established for g2; baseline g0 claim unchanged
separate_restriction_comparison.interpretation: Fewer relevant labeled observations, not demonstrated true-risk increase
